sources.summaryEn: Explains the stepped final-damage multiplier from team power vs. a stage's recommended power (sourced from crumblehub.co). Below 100% of the recommendation, damage drops in steps. At 120% or more it caps at 120%. This is for stages. The post doesn't say whether Guild Conquest uses it.

sources.title: [📚정보] 스킬가속 정리
sources.summaryEn: Datamine of game version 1.1.002. Skill haste uses the LoL-style formula: final CD = base CD × 100/(100+haste). Only the root skill cooldown is hasted. Internal delays of multi-stage skills, such as child spawn delays and dash intervals, are not. That is why haste seems to work differently per cookie.

sources.title: [📚정보] 치명 관련 스탯 정리
sources.summaryEn: Datamine of the crit system. Crit rate above 100% gives tiered crits: 1st/2nd/3rd-degree crits, where the integer part is guaranteed and the fraction is the chance of the next tier. Crit multiplier = 1 + tier × (0.5 + bonus crit dmg). Past 100% effective crit rate, crit damage is worth more per point than crit rate. Sugar-rune max per line is 8% for both crit rate and crit damage.

sources.summaryEn: Lift resistance shortens airborne time; it is not a chance to ignore the lift. Base 20% + Pinot Noir 35% = 48%, and adding the Panda Dumpling pet's 20% gives 64%, so a 1 s lift drops to 0.36 s and no longer cancels skills. The OP also gives lift durations for several cookies.

sources.title: 토벌 치확이 필요함?

sources.summaryEn: Author: boss has no crit res so is crit rate needed? Answers: crit rate above 100% keeps adding — every 100% of crit rate adds another crit-damage instance (200% = crits twice; 198% = one crit plus 98% chance of a second). So crit rate is 'more is better'; one says always double crit rate (치확 둘둘). Unresolved whether 치확 or 치피 is better when forced to choose.

Replies favour the latter: 1.4 crit rate ≈ 1 crit dmg in value, but higher 스증 always wins; aim for +15 pieces with 치확/치피 20%+ and 스증 9%+. 340 notes their arena set (치확) scored lower in raid than the raid set (치피).

sources.titleEn: Bright Seeker Cookie skill haste research
sources.summaryEn: Modelled expected Bright Seeker damage (raid only) for 43 s fights, where the team dies with 17 s left, and 30 s fights, where it dies at the 30 s slam. The model uses three gear baselines, trades rune haste against rune skill amp 1:1, and finds a haste threshold at about 40 total. Crit rate and crit damage runes never beat haste or amp. Recommendations: whales run 8 haste lines, mid spenders target total skill haste 41–45, and F2P players who die at the 30 s slam should go skill amp and crit damage, because haste is negative in 30 s fights. The author's deck (Macaron and Cheesecake on 스증, everyone levelled down to Cheesecake's ATK, Jungle Warrior instead of Herb) scored 339G 975M at 912.73M (about 372x). After Seeker went to 8★ it scored 367G 994M. Last season's max was 250x, and a low-spec variant uses 딸크 and 방어구 수리특약.

decks.summary: Everyone except the buffers is levelled down to Cheesecake's ATK so Cheesecake herself receives Pomegranate's beam and passes a bigger ATK buff to Milk. Documented by the author of the skill-haste study.

The standard high-end deck since 9/20. Five cookies sit at Lv.1 so Pomegranate's +69% skill-amp beams land only on the carries, and Cherry pulls the team into a straight line so Macaron's crit-rate buff reaches Brightseeker.
decks.formation: No move speed on any rune or gear piece. Cherry does the aligning; any move speed breaks it.
decks.perks: Leader Milk. 복지 (welfare): 열정페이 + 초고속승진, both landing on Milk. Mercenary squad Lv.4 for the second welfare slot and the third pet slot.
decks.rng: At 1.74G power, 1T lands in 1–2 of 10 runs and 1.1T occasionally. At 0.97G the author reports a 150× floor, a 250–350× average and a 400×+ peak. Ten minutes of hand play gives about 300–350×; the 400× record took 14 hours of overnight macro retries.
decks.atkOrderNote: Order by 공격력 (ATK), not 전투력 (power). Pomegranate is outside the order. If Macaron still has ATK runes it becomes Milk › Brightseeker › Macaron › Skating Queen › Tea Knight › Cheesecake.

decks.summary: The survival fallback for accounts whose team dies at the 30 s slam. Herb replaces Tiger Lily, so Pomegranate fires 5 beams and only ATK ranks 1–5 matter.
decks.perks: 열정페이 fixed, plus 초고속승진 (or a survival perk if the team is still dying).
decks.rng: Raises the floor more than the ceiling. One poster went from about 93× to 228× at 540M by fixing perks, with no deck change.

decks.summary: Week-2 ceiling deck. It needs a run where Cheesecake's ATK buff hits only Milk and Scorpion. Superseded by the level-down and Cherry decks.
decks.rng: The author played 4,230 runs in one season and still finished around 87×.

decks.summary: Replaces Cherry with Melon Soda and aligns the team through move speed on sugar runes. Higher peak per power than Cherry when the line forms, but the tuning is per-account and unforgiving.
decks.formation: Move speed only from sugar runes, on Brightseeker, Pinot and Melon Soda. None on gear. The target is a single line (일렬).
decks.rng: The source player gets a good alignment in about 3 of 4 runs. A 0.03 speed difference can stop the line forming at all. The same setup aligned on one device and not on another (Galaxy vs Lenovo tablet).

deckCookies.why: ATK #1 on purpose. The 열정페이 (+20% ATK) and 초고속승진 (+7% ATK) perks go to the highest-ATK ally, and Milk's own ATK buff scales with her ATK, so every point she gains is shared with the team. She's also always inside Pomegranate's beam set. Sugar runes are all ATK%, and 10★ matters.

deckCookies.levelRule: Lv.100, or as high as possible while ATK < Milk
deckCookies.why: The damage carry (one poster puts her above 90% of team damage) and a Light attacker against a Dark boss. She has to be ATK #2 so she's always in Pomegranate's beams. Stars matter a lot: posters measured +25–47% going 4★ → 5★ (5★ adds a drone), and one estimates about 1000× at 10★.

mechanics.title: Pomegranate's beams (빨대)
mechanics.body: Her skill gives +69% skill amp for 9 s through beams. The beam count scales with multi-hit (다발) synergy: 3 at the start, 5 with Herb, 6 with Tiger Lily. Beams go to the highest-ATK allies (ATK, not power) and never to herself. Her level and ATK don't change the buff.

mechanics.title: Milk and the welfare perks
mechanics.body: Milk's ATK buff scales with her ATK. 열정페이 (+20% ATK, −20% max HP) and 초고속승진 (+7% ATK) go to the highest-ATK ally, so Milk has to be ATK #1. Milk usually dies at the 17 s wipe because of 열정페이's HP cut.

mechanics.title: Cheesecake's buff overrides Milk's
mechanics.body: A cookie holding Cheesecake's ATK buff loses Milk's: measured 483K ATK with Milk alone vs 228K with both. The best case is Cheesecake buffing Milk (667K), which is why formation matters.

mechanics.title: Crit above 100%
mechanics.body: Crit rate past 100% rolls extra crit tiers: 200% always crits twice, and 198% is one crit plus a 98% chance of a second. Each tier adds (50% + bonus crit dmg). Above 100% effective crit rate, +10% crit dmg beats +10% crit rate. The raid boss has no crit resistance.

mechanics.title: Skill haste formula
mechanics.body: Cooldown = base × 100 / (100 + haste). 50 haste cuts a cooldown by 33%, not 50%. Only the parent skill's cooldown is hasted; internal delays and durations aren't. No cap was found in the data.

mechanics.title: Brightseeker haste breakpoint
mechanics.body: A model of a 43 s fight finds haste pays off steeply until about 40 total, then stalls. In a 30 s fight (team dies at the slam), trading haste for skill amp is better: going from 20 to 40 haste loses about 3.4%. Past about 58 haste her drones start splitting onto adds.

mechanics.title: Lift resistance
mechanics.body: A skill is cancelled if its cookie is airborne for 0.4 s or more. Resistance stacks as base + extra − base×extra: 20% base, 48% with Pinot, 64% with Pinot plus a 20% pet. Candy Shade Pouch goes up to 30% (plus 12.5% HP).

mechanics.title: Skill amp nerf (8/27)
mechanics.body: Skill amp no longer boosts stat-reduction debuffs (Dark Choco included) or damage-reduction buffs, and enemy DEF can't go below 0. That's why Dark Choco runs haste.

mechanics.title: Boss
mechanics.body: 지나치게 무거워진 피냐타 (Extra Stuffed Piñata) is Dark with a Light weakness (Brightseeker is Light). Big slam at 30 s elapsed; super-jump wipe at 17 s remaining. Crit resistance on your side does nothing here, and accuracy and focus aren't needed.

mechanics.title: Octo Wasabi pet
mechanics.body: +40% duration-synergy effect and +10% ATK for duration-synergy allies. The pet card says 10%; posters and one video guide measure +8% when Scorpion enters (disputed). The bonus isn't shown on the stat screen, so ATK-order tuning has to add it by hand, and it can reshuffle the order mid-fight.

mechanics.title: Tea Knight is raid-only
mechanics.body: Every 10 s: a 155.2% ATK thunder strike and all allies Boss DMG +70% for 10 s, in Guild Conquest only (+45% at the lowest grade). That's why she's in every top deck. She stands at the front and often misses Milk's buff, which is the most common cause of stray beams.

mechanics.title: Surviving the 17 s wipe
mechanics.body: Posters put the floor at about 9M HP and 45% damage reduction per surviving cookie. A 9.4M HP / 45.6% DR Brightseeker lived to about 9 s left using HP and DR pets. The ATK-order carries (about 5M HP) and Milk (열정페이 HP cut) still die; at 21G account power, Macaron, Brightseeker, Pomegranate and Skating Queen survived and kept dealing damage until 8 s left. This is the leading explanation for the Season 5 jump, but only as a timing match.

mechanics.title: No manual control since 9/10
mechanics.body: Manual control in Guild Conquest was removed on 9/10, so placement comes from deck composition only. That's why a Lv.1 Cherry Cookie is carried: it pushes Brightseeker in front of Macaron.

mechanics.title: Skill amp scales Milk's buff (8/13)
mechanics.body: Since the 8/13 patch skill amp applies to Milk's ATK-increase effect, which is why Milk is ATK #1 and the leader in every top deck.

mechanics.title: Weapon: crit rate or crit dmg
mechanics.body: At equal skill amp, check crit rate after Macaron's buff: under 30 (the last two digits) take crit dmg, at 30 or more take crit rate to push the next crit tier. Skill amp wins over both when it's higher.

mechanics.title: HP to survive the slam
mechanics.body: Cookies need about 3.5–4M HP to live through the 30 s slam. Level barely matters for that, because gear and lab HP research give a Lv.1 cookie about 4M HP in raid.

mechanics.title: Sugar rune slots and rolls
mechanics.body: Rune slots unlock with stars (★6, two at ★8, two at ★10). Per-line maxima: ATK% 7, crit rate 8, crit dmg 8, skill amp 5 (SSR), skill haste +5 (SSR; SR tops out at +3).

mechanics.title: Gear enhancement
mechanics.body: Sub-options jump at +5, +10, +15 and +20 (+130% at +15, +200% at +20). Max skill-haste roll is +4.6 at +15. Only accessory groups roll haste.

fightEvents.detail: Guild Conquest fight lasts 60 s total, confirmed independently by crumb.gg's DPS chart page ('Fight length 60 s', evidence/15-crumbgg/32-dps-read.txt) and by a datamine poster ('토벌전이 60초', dc:71383). The in-run HUD timer counts down from 60 to 0 (dc:69724, prior evidence); '17초' and '30초' in community shorthand are both remaining-time marks, i.e. elapsed 43 s and elapsed 30 s respectively.

Team runs in from starting positions and collides into a line; there is no scripted stop point; a cookie keeps advancing until physically blocked by an ally or the boss, so leftover move-speed stats or missing backline units change where the line settles (dc:72759, dc:74804; prior evidence dc:60340, dc:64839).

Per an unverified single-author datamine (dc:67285, refined in dc:71383): boss damage reduction is 0% and boss ATK is at its base value (5000) for the first 10 s. This is the highest-damage-efficiency window of the fight, before the boss starts scaling up its own mitigation and offense.
Datamine claim: boss DR steps to 10% and boss ATK jumps to 505,000 at 10 s elapsed. DEF stays fixed at 2000 throughout (matches the independent DEF figure in dc:67299 by the same author).
Datamine claim: DR steps to 30%, boss ATK to 2,500,500.

A distinct sub-event around 27 s remaining, separate from the 30 s slam: thrown mobs ('쫄') self-destruct near the front line. A fully-built (Lv.100) Dark Choco was reported dying to this specifically, while a Lv.1 Dark Choco instead died to the 30 s slam itself (dc:71219); matches the '3 bomb mobs thrown at the front line' step of the previously-recorded 30 s sequence (dc:53667, prior evidence).

The '30 s slam' ('30초 쿵'/'30초 내려찍기'/'부랄찢기'): the boss's first major team-wide hit. Prior evidence (dc:53667) describes the full sequence as gift-bomb -> ground pounds -> 3 bomb-mobs thrown at the front line -> jump. This batch adds concrete HP survival floors (~3-4M HP generally, front row ~4.5M / back row ~3.5M as a more granular split) and a team-power curve (~400M power = 1-2 survivors, ~600M = full survival, ~1.5G = never dies here). It is RNG-sensitive even at fixed power/build (one account cleared it on a 3rd retry after 2 failures at identical build).
